description.value: River Road Café is a family-run Brazilian café in Richmond bringing authentic flavours — from street-food pastels and party snacks to imported Brazilian goods — to the table. Founded by a Brazilian couple and their team, the café offers dine-in meals, an online shop with home delivery for frozen and imported products, and catering services. It sits along River Road, a popular cycling corridor on the south arm of the Fraser River.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is a real, active Brazilian café at 11782 River Road, Richmond, BC, with the same phone number as OSM (+1 604 278-1416). The site describes dine-in, a shop selling frozen/imported Brazilian goods with home delivery, and catering services, but makes no mention of cyclist-specific amenities such as bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or Wi-Fi. OSM supplied only a postcode for the address; the website provides the full street address, which I have used.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active Brazilian café on a well-used cycling route in Richmond with a functioning website and confirmed contact details; no grounds for exclusion.
